title: Callvale at demo day
claim: At demo day, one hand-built instance in one Availability Zone runs everything, and the review marks its high-risk findings.
alt: One instance in one Availability Zone runs the web application, the worker and the database; a public bucket holds the audio. Markers show six of the review's findings: the root user's access key in the code, the public bucket, an open database port, SSH open to the world, one volume and no backups.
notes: Decision record story pair, flow left to right (STARTUP A7 rule 13). Claim and alt from brief.json; no steps. Findings: root key (red icon, ring), security group with SSH and database port open (red border), public bucket and the one volume (ring). The ring is the theme accent, not red: the alt's 'Red markers' is only partly true (report). Region and AZ are generic groups to match aws-map-after (lint: no lone Region box, at most two az groups). No AWS number drawn.
